kv2.8:1.3: Nanu atthi sukhā vedanā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ, dibbaṃ sukhaṃ, mānusakaṃ sukhaṃ, lābhasukhaṃ, sakkārasukhaṃ, yānasukhaṃ, sayanasukhaṃ, issariyasukhaṃ, adhipaccasukhaṃ, gihīsukhaṃ, sāmaññasukhaṃ, sāsavaṃ sukhaṃ, anāsavaṃ sukhaṃ, upadhisukhaṃ, nirupadhisukhaṃ, sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, nisāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, sappītikaṃ sukhaṃ, nippītikaṃ sukhaṃ, jhānasukhaṃ, vimuttasukhaṃ, kāmasukhaṃ, nekkhammasukhaṃ, pavivekasukhaṃ, upasamasukhaṃ, sambodhisukhan ti?
kv2.8:3.7: Cakkhuṃ Bhikkhave ādittaṃ, rūpā ādittā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, cakkhusamphasso āditto,
kv2.8:3.8: yaṃ p' idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, taṃ pi ādiṭṭhaṃ.
kv2.8:3.10: Rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan ti vadāmi.
kv2.8:3.15: mano āditto, dhammā ādittā, manoviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, manosamphasso āditto,
kv2.8:3.16: yaṃ p' idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, taṃ pi ādittaṃ.
kv2.8:3.18: Rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan ti vadāmīti."
kv2.8:4.6: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, sotaviññeyyā saddā --pe--
kv2.8:4.9: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā:
kv2.8:4.10: ime kho Bhikkhave pañca kāmaguṇā ti."
kv2.8:5.5: "Lābhā vo Bhikkhave, suladdhaṃ vo Bhikkhave, khaṇo vo paṭividdho brahmacariyavāsāya.
kv2.8:5.6: Diṭṭhā mayā Bhikkhave cha phassāyatanikā nāma nirayā,
kv2.8:5.7: tattha yaṃ kiñci cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, aniṭṭharūpañ ñeva passati, no iṭṭharūpaṃ; akantarūpañ ñeva passati, no kantarūpaṃ; amanāparūpañ ñeva passati, no manāparūpaṃ:
kv2.8:5.12: manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti, aniṭṭharūpañ ñeva vijānāti, no iṭṭharūpaṃ; akantarūpañ ñeva vijānāti, no kantarūpaṃ; amanāparūpañ ñeva vijānāti, no manāparūpan ti."
kv2.8:6.4: "Lābhā vo Bhikkhave, suladdhaṃ vo Bhikkhave, khaṇo vo paṭividdho brahmacariyavāsāya.
kv2.8:6.5: Diṭṭhā mayā Bhikkhave cha phassāyatanikā nāma saggā,
kv2.8:6.6: tattha yaṃ kiñci cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, iṭṭharūpañ ñeva passati, no aniṭṭharūpaṃ; kantarūpañ ñeva passati, no akantarūpaṃ; manāparūpañ ñeva passati, no amanāparūpaṃ:
kv2.8:6.11: manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti, iṭṭharūpañ ñeva vijānāti, no aniṭṭharūpaṃ; kantarūpañ ñeva passati, no akantarūpaṃ; manāparūpañ ñeva passati, no amanāparūpan ti."
kv2.8:7.4: Nanu yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā,
kv2.8:7.7: Hañci yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā,
kv2.8:7.8: sabbe saṃkhārā aniccā, tena vata re vattabbe
kv2.8:8.3: Dānaṃ aniṭṭhaphalaṃ akantaphalaṃ amanuññaphalaṃ secanakaphalaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ dukkhavipākan ti?
